bull_bear.body:
- NARCL residual ₹380 cr (vs ₹700 cr agreed), prepaying ahead of schedule; minimum ₹45 cr more in FY27 to neutralize FY27-28 liability; then attack FY28-29.
- Deleveraging funded ~entirely by arbitration award monetization (~75% of proceeds → NARCL), NOT operating cash flow → operating surplus freed for growth (BESS capex, WC).
- Equity raised ₹476 cr (promoter-heavy) demonstrates skin-in-the-game; bank limit ₹505 cr; surety bonds ₹305 cr to economize on BG/margin.
- No dividend discussed. Tax shield: accumulated losses >₹500 cr + new tax regime (no MAT) → minimal cash tax for "a few years."
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation (deleveraging — central)

bull_bear.body:
- **Arbitration dependency:** Entire deleveraging thesis hinges on timely arbitration realizations (~40% claim-to-award conversion assumed; some at Supreme Court — timing/quantum uncertain).
- **Legacy NARCL dues** still ₹380 cr on books despite "effectively debt-free" framing.
- **Working capital / receivables:** receivables jumped to ₹417.5 cr; reliance on escrow/back-to-back netting; govt-payment cycle risk (esp. PHED/state water vs NTPC/PowerGrid which pay in 15–30 days).
- **Jal Jeevan payment risk:** mgmt acknowledges JJM payments were stopped for verification (now resuming); SPML avoided JJM during stress, only re-entering selectively.
- **Funding-paced execution:** revenue calibrated to customer fund availability → top-line lumpiness (FY26 miss); West-Asia-war crude/supply headwinds (mitigated by PV clauses).
- **BESS execution risk:** new manufacturing vertical, ambitious capacity ramp, oversupply concern (mgmt downplays via Energy Vault tie-up + 30-40 yr power EPC pedigree).
- **One-off-reliant Q4 PAT** (tax reversal + liability write-back) — quality of earnings.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, detailed, candid on the FY26 turnover miss (owned it, explained funding discipline). Repeatedly stresses "SPML 2.0" discipline — quality over volume, ≥10% margin floor, PV clause, fully-funded orders only. CFO Manoj Digga dominated; technical BESS depth from Malay Chakraborti. Framing of "effectively debt-free" is optimistic and should be read against ₹380 cr residual NARCL + arbitration-timing risk. Promoter has injected meaningful equity — alignment positive.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The real deleveraging engine is the litigation book (~₹4,500 cr claims), not EBITDA — SPML is partly an arbitration-recovery story dressed as an EPC.
- "Order book met, turnover missed" — for an EPC the order book is the leading indicator; FY26 shortfall is a timing (funding-paced) issue that converts to FY27-28 revenue, not a demand loss.
- BESS is genuinely differentiated optionality (only Indian player with Energy Vault tie-up + own battery-pack/container manufacturing) but is capacity/execution unproven — a 5 GW line implies ~₹5,000 cr revenue potential vs ₹868 cr current total.
- Margin trajectory is structurally up purely on mix shift (legacy run-off → new ≥10% orders) even before BESS scales.
- Back-to-back legacy contracts inflate gross receivables/payables but are cash-flow-neutral — headline WC looks worse than economic reality.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Net worth grew from Rs 509 Cr (FY24) to Rs 819 Cr (FY25) to Rs 999 Cr (FY26); Debt-to-Equity declined from 1.1x (FY24) to 0.4x (FY26) and further to 0.34x (Jun-26); ROE improved from 4% (FY24) to 8% (FY26).
- Equity raised since 2022 via preferential allotment to fund growth in Water, Power and BESS plus capex/working capital; the deck states two different totals in different slides - Rs 819 Cr (promoters ~Rs 400 Cr) on the Preferential Allotment slide vs Rs 650 Cr (promoters Rs 388 Cr) on the Key Strengths slide.
- NARCL/IDRCL legacy debt: Rs 700 Cr settlement structured over 8 years, of which Rs 325 Cr already repaid and Rs 375 Cr outstanding, to be serviced from arbitration award proceeds (Rs 678 Cr in hand against Rs 4,526 Cr of claims filed, ~40% expected to convert to awards); no additional interest outgo anticipated.
- Credit profile strengthened: CRISIL assigned and ICRA upgraded rating to BBB (Stable); Rs 860 Cr credit facility enhancement from a PSU bank plus ~Rs 300 Cr surety bond drawl to support execution and bidding capacity.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Revenue mix (Q4):** ~85–90% water, balance power (power still small).
- **Legacy vs new:** Legacy = back-to-back contracts taken during debt resolution, no WC/execution liability for SPML, small-but-protected margin, runs off 2–3 yrs. New orders = ≥10% margin, price-protected (PV clause), funded, lower complexity — proportion rising → margin accretion from FY27.
- **BESS bifurcation:** battery pack ~35–40% of EPC value (mfg at Supa), container ~8–10% (mfg starting), rest EPC. NTPC order O&M ₹96 cr; rest EPC. Segment-level BESS/power accounting to begin once BESS commences.
- No explicit SPV monetization (asset-light; growth via EPC + manufacturing, not BOT/SPV).

business.body:
- Water EPC Qualification Moat: proven execution of 400+ MLD WTPs, 10,000+ km pipelines and up to 20-year O&M contracts positions SPML among the few fully pre-qualified players able to convert accelerated water-sector tenders (JJM, AMRUT) into repeat orders.
- BESS + Energy Vault tie-up: an exclusive 10-year partnership with Energy Vault (US) gives access to proven global storage technology; combined with 45+ years of power & grid execution legacy, SPML positions itself as an early mover in utility-scale BESS deployment.
- Recognized among the World's Top 50 Private Water Companies and India's 50 Best Real Estate & Infrastructure Companies; nearly 700 infrastructure projects executed over four decades in water, wastewater, power T&D and rural electrification.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Sector Tailwinds] Deck cites a GOI water-sector pipeline of Rs 17 lakh crore+, power investments doubling to ~Rs 2.3 lakh crore over FY26-FY28, and a BESS market estimated at ~$8.4 Bn today growing toward ~$57 Bn by 2031-32.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Target ≥10% EBITDA on all new business (hard floor — "less than 10%, we don't do any business"). FY26 reported EBITDA margin 9.7%; Q4 8.4% optically low on one-offs.
- Margin lift mechanism: rising share of new (higher-margin, price-protected) orders vs legacy low-margin JV; all new orders carry PV (price-variation) clause → escalation/crude-price protection.
- Labor: already accruing per new Labor Code, no cost shock; labor availability not an issue.
- BESS margins: EPC and OEM both ~10%; OEM faster turnaround.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body: - **Q4 FY26 (this):** First note in series. FY26 = stated inflection year. Revenue ₹293.9 cr (+53% YoY, +27% QoQ); FY26 rev ₹868 cr (+13%), EBITDA ₹86 cr (9.7%, +37%), PAT ₹76 cr (+55%). OB ~₹5,369 cr. NARCL down to ₹380 cr (vs ₹700 cr) — prepaying ahead via arbitration awards; ₹476 cr equity raised since May-24. NTPC BESS ₹1,128 cr won; Supa 2.5 GW line live ~Jun-26, 5 GW by end-FY27. Guidance: >25% top- & bottom-line growth FY27; ~10% EBITDA floor; ₹2,500–3,000 cr net new orders/yr. FY26 turnover missed ₹900–1,000 cr guide (₹868 cr) on funding-paced execution.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **Revenue:** ">25% growth in FY27" at both top line AND bottom line; growth momentum to continue subsequent years. Quarter-on-quarter increase expected each quarter. ~₹50–100 cr of FY26 execution shortfall spills into FY27 (mostly Q1/Q2).
- **Margin:** EBITDA target ~10%; expected to rise as new-order mix increases (all new orders ≥10%, legacy small-but-protected). Detailed FY27/FY28 split deferred — yearly guidance to be given at each annual call.
- **Order inflow:** Total order book target ~₹5,000 cr/yr; own (net-of-JV) new-order target ₹2,500–3,000 cr/yr (internal stretch ₹4,000–5,000 cr); annual execution/sales ₹2,500–3,000 cr. "Not less than last year." Deliberately selective.
- **Deleveraging target:** Pay minimum ₹45 cr to NARCL in FY27 (makes FY27-28 liability "almost negligible"); start prepaying FY28-29 dues this year. All linked to arbitration realizations, not operating cash flow.
- **FY26 scorecard vs guidance:** Met on order acquisition, EBITDA and PAT-margin; MISSED turnover (₹868 cr vs ₹900–1,000 cr guided) — attributed to calibrating execution to customer fund availability (March year-end pressure + West-Asia-war-related fund constraint on a few tenders e.g. RITES).
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- Consolidated OB ~₹5,369 cr (₹4,000 cr new + ₹1,369 cr legacy low-margin JV/back-to-back, to run off in 2–3 yrs). ~₹1,300 cr power (BESS + substation). Net-of-consortium water OB ~₹3,300 cr.
- **Marquee win:** NTPC BESS order ₹1,128 cr (largest-ever; Energy Vault technical handholding; 1 GW; 18-month delivery + O&M ₹96 cr / 15-yr; full integration incl. 220 kV substation, BMS at Supa).
- New water orders: Konar (Ranchi, NABARD-funded), Indore (AMRUT), Kekri (Jal Jeevan 2.0 — milestone achieved). Pipeline: big tenders in MP, Maharashtra; river-linking Ken-Betwa & PKC (MP), Wainganga-Nalganga (Maharashtra), UP river-linking — centrally/World-Bank/GCA funded. Ken-Betwa at pre-bid stage (tender expected soon).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **BESS (key optionality):** 2.5 GW assembly line at Supa MIDC Pune commencing ~end-Jun-2026; expand to 5 GW + 600 containerized BESS units/yr by end-FY27. Peak revenue potential ~₹2,500 cr (2.5 GW) → ~₹5,000 cr (5 GW). Three models — EPC (~10%), OEM battery-pack supply to other EPCs (~10%, 3–6 month turnaround), O&M. India BESS TAM cited 236 GW by 2031-32; market ~$2 bn (2026) → $8.6 bn (2031), ~33% CAGR; 10% BESS mandate on renewables.
- **River-linking / irrigation:** Ken-Betwa, PKC, Wainganga-Nalganga — focus optionality for FY27-28.
- **Power T&D / substations:** leading player; rising govt focus (Union Budget energy allocation ₹1,09,029 cr).
- **Long-term mix goal:** water ~50% / power+BESS ~50% by FY30 (from current 75:25 → balancing).

financial scorecard:
**Q4 FY26 (consolidated):**
- **Revenue:** ₹293.9 cr, +53% YoY, +27% QoQ.
- **EBITDA:** ₹25 cr, margin 8.4% (reported). Depressed by one-offs: legal/consultancy costs on arbitration matter; non-cash ECL provision (Ind AS); bank-limit mobilization costs (~₹10 cr aggregate increase in other expenditure). Normalized margin ~10% per mgmt.
- **PAT:** ₹28 cr, +140% YoY. Aided by tax reversal (recognition of tax benefit on accumulated income-tax losses) and write-back of operating liabilities booked under other income.

**FY26 (full year, consolidated):**
- **Revenue:** ₹868 cr, +13% YoY (mgmt also cites "~₹887 cr"; guidance was ₹900–1,000 cr → shortfall, see §3).
- **EBITDA:** ₹86 cr, +37% YoY; margin 9.7%.
- **PAT:** ₹76 cr, +55% YoY.

**Order book:** Consolidated OB ₹5,369 cr entering Q4 (~₹4,000 cr new + ₹1,369 cr legacy); inflection-point figure also cited as ₹5,368 cr / ₹5,616 cr (incl. ~₹1,300 cr power inc. BESS + substation). Net-of-consortium water OB ≈ ₹3,300 cr. New orders ≥₹4,280 cr (incl. JV share) secured since FY25.

**Net debt / deleveraging [KEY]:**
- D/E rose to 0.4x; Net debt/EBITDA 4.41x; ROE 8%.
- **NARCL:** total outstanding incl. interest ₹380 cr as on 31-Mar-26 vs agreed ₹700 cr. Cumulative paid over 3 yrs ₹319–320 cr vs agreed ₹271 cr (i.e. prepaid ahead of schedule; ₹47–48 cr prepayment against FY27-28 dues).
- **Arbitration:** ₹312–315 cr awards received since resolution; ~₹627–630 cr awards in hand (advanced/Supreme-Court stage); ~₹4,500 cr additional claims pending (~40% historical conversion → ~₹1,500 cr expected). ~75% of award proceeds routed to NARCL. Mgmt: "effectively a debt-free company" on a cash-flow basis — surplus cash reserved for growth, not NARCL.
- **Liquidity:** ₹476 cr raised since May-2024 (promoter contribution ₹313.5 cr, over and above ₹112.5 cr in the difficult period). Bank credit limit enhanced to ₹505 cr; surety-bond exposure ₹305 cr (in lieu of BG, low margin).

**Working capital:** Trade receivables up ₹299.55 cr → ₹417.50 cr; of which ₹137 cr back-to-back (matched creditor liability, no WC blocked), ₹186 cr "normal" debtors (realize in normal cycle), balance retention/others. Creditors rose in tandem (escrow mechanism — debtors covered by creditors, company fund minimally used). Other current assets up on Ind AS inventory provision.

- **Margin:** EBITDA target ~10%; expected to rise as new-order mix increases (all new orders ≥10%, legacy small-but-protected). Detailed FY27/FY28 split deferred — yearly guidance to be given at each annual call.
- **Order inflow:** Total order book target ~₹5,000 cr/yr; own (net-of-JV) new-order target ₹2,500–3,000 cr/yr (internal stretch ₹4,000–5,000 cr); annual execution/sales ₹2,500–3,000 cr. "Not less than last year." Deliberately selective.
- **Deleveraging target:** Pay minimum ₹45 cr to NARCL in FY27 (makes FY27-28 liability "almost negligible"); start prepaying FY28-29 dues this year. All linked to arbitration realizations, not operating cash flow.
- **FY26 scorecard vs guidance:** Met on order acquisition, EBITDA and PAT-margin; MISSED turnover (₹868 cr vs ₹900–1,000 cr guided) — attributed to calibrating execution to customer fund availability (March year-end pressure + West-Asia-war-related fund constraint on a few tenders e.g. RITES).

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **BESS (key optionality):** 2.5 GW assembly line at Supa MIDC Pune commencing ~end-Jun-2026; expand to 5 GW + 600 containerized BESS units/yr by end-FY27. Peak revenue potential ~₹2,500 cr (2.5 GW) → ~₹5,000 cr (5 GW). Three models — EPC (~10%), OEM battery-pack supply to other EPCs (~10%, 3–6 month turnaround), O&M. India BESS TAM cited 236 GW by 2031-32; market ~$2 bn (2026) → $8.6 bn (2031), ~33% CAGR; 10% BESS mandate on renewables.
- **River-linking / irrigation:** Ken-Betwa, PKC, Wainganga-Nalganga — focus optionality for FY27-28.
- **Power T&D / substations:** leading player; rising govt focus (Union Budget energy allocation ₹1,09,029 cr).
- **Long-term mix goal:** water ~50% / power+BESS ~50% by FY30 (from current 75:25 → balancing).

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- Target ≥10% EBITDA on all new business (hard floor — "less than 10%, we don't do any business"). FY26 reported EBITDA margin 9.7%; Q4 8.4% optically low on one-offs.
- Margin lift mechanism: rising share of new (higher-margin, price-protected) orders vs legacy low-margin JV; all new orders carry PV (price-variation) clause → escalation/crude-price protection.
- Labor: already accruing per new Labor Code, no cost shock; labor availability not an issue.
- BESS margins: EPC and OEM both ~10%; OEM faster turnaround.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation (deleveraging — central)
capital_allocation.body:
- NARCL residual ₹380 cr (vs ₹700 cr agreed), prepaying ahead of schedule; minimum ₹45 cr more in FY27 to neutralize FY27-28 liability; then attack FY28-29.
- Deleveraging funded ~entirely by arbitration award monetization (~75% of proceeds → NARCL), NOT operating cash flow → operating surplus freed for growth (BESS capex, WC).
- Equity raised ₹476 cr (promoter-heavy) demonstrates skin-in-the-game; bank limit ₹505 cr; surety bonds ₹305 cr to economize on BG/margin.
- No dividend discussed. Tax shield: accumulated losses >₹500 cr + new tax regime (no MAT) → minimal cash tax for "a few years."

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, detailed, candid on the FY26 turnover miss (owned it, explained funding discipline). Repeatedly stresses "SPML 2.0" discipline — quality over volume, ≥10% margin floor, PV clause, fully-funded orders only. CFO Manoj Digga dominated; technical BESS depth from Malay Chakraborti. Framing of "effectively debt-free" is optimistic and should be read against ₹380 cr residual NARCL + arbitration-timing risk. Promoter has injected meaningful equity — alignment positive.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Arbitration dependency:** Entire deleveraging thesis hinges on timely arbitration realizations (~40% claim-to-award conversion assumed; some at Supreme Court — timing/quantum uncertain).
- **Legacy NARCL dues** still ₹380 cr on books despite "effectively debt-free" framing.
- **Working capital / receivables:** receivables jumped to ₹417.5 cr; reliance on escrow/back-to-back netting; govt-payment cycle risk (esp. PHED/state water vs NTPC/PowerGrid which pay in 15–30 days).
- **Jal Jeevan payment risk:** mgmt acknowledges JJM payments were stopped for verification (now resuming); SPML avoided JJM during stress, only re-entering selectively.
- **Funding-paced execution:** revenue calibrated to customer fund availability → top-line lumpiness (FY26 miss); West-Asia-war crude/supply headwinds (mitigated by PV clauses).
- **BESS execution risk:** new manufacturing vertical, ambitious capacity ramp, oversupply concern (mgmt downplays via Energy Vault tie-up + 30-40 yr power EPC pedigree).
- **One-off-reliant Q4 PAT** (tax reversal + liability write-back) — quality of earnings.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- The real deleveraging engine is the litigation book (~₹4,500 cr claims), not EBITDA — SPML is partly an arbitration-recovery story dressed as an EPC.
- "Order book met, turnover missed" — for an EPC the order book is the leading indicator; FY26 shortfall is a timing (funding-paced) issue that converts to FY27-28 revenue, not a demand loss.
- BESS is genuinely differentiated optionality (only Indian player with Energy Vault tie-up + own battery-pack/container manufacturing) but is capacity/execution unproven — a 5 GW line implies ~₹5,000 cr revenue potential vs ₹868 cr current total.
- Margin trajectory is structurally up purely on mix shift (legacy run-off → new ≥10% orders) even before BESS scales.
- Back-to-back legacy contracts inflate gross receivables/payables but are cash-flow-neutral — headline WC looks worse than economic reality.

qoq_log.title: QoQ change log
qoq_log.body: - **Q4 FY26 (this):** First note in series. FY26 = stated inflection year. Revenue ₹293.9 cr (+53% YoY, +27% QoQ); FY26 rev ₹868 cr (+13%), EBITDA ₹86 cr (9.7%, +37%), PAT ₹76 cr (+55%). OB ~₹5,369 cr. NARCL down to ₹380 cr (vs ₹700 cr) — prepaying ahead via arbitration awards; ₹476 cr equity raised since May-24. NTPC BESS ₹1,128 cr won; Supa 2.5 GW line live ~Jun-26, 5 GW by end-FY27. Guidance: >25% top- & bottom-line growth FY27; ~10% EBITDA floor; ₹2,500–3,000 cr net new orders/yr. FY26 turnover missed ₹900–1,000 cr guide (₹868 cr) on funding-paced execution.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body: - [Sector Tailwinds] Deck cites a GOI water-sector pipeline of Rs 17 lakh crore+, power investments doubling to ~Rs 2.3 lakh crore over FY26-FY28, and a BESS market estimated at ~$8.4 Bn today growing toward ~$57 Bn by 2031-32.

financial scorecard:

- **Revenue:** ₹293.9 cr, +53% YoY, +27% QoQ.
- **EBITDA:** ₹25 cr, margin 8.4% (reported). Depressed by one-offs: legal/consultancy costs on arbitration matter; non-cash ECL provision (Ind AS); bank-limit mobilization costs (~₹10 cr aggregate increase in other expenditure). Normalized margin ~10% per mgmt.
- **PAT:** ₹28 cr, +140% YoY. Aided by tax reversal (recognition of tax benefit on accumulated income-tax losses) and write-back of operating liabilities booked under other income.

**FY26 (full year, consolidated):**
- **Revenue:** ₹868 cr, +13% YoY (mgmt also cites "~₹887 cr"; guidance was ₹900–1,000 cr → shortfall, see §3).
- **EBITDA:** ₹86 cr, +37% YoY; margin 9.7%.
- **PAT:** ₹76 cr, +55% YoY.

**Order book:** Consolidated OB ₹5,369 cr entering Q4 (~₹4,000 cr new + ₹1,369 cr legacy); inflection-point figure also cited as ₹5,368 cr / ₹5,616 cr (incl. ~₹1,300 cr power inc. BESS + substation). Net-of-consortium water OB ≈ ₹3,300 cr. New orders ≥₹4,280 cr (incl. JV share) secured since FY25.

**Net debt / deleveraging [KEY]:**

- **NARCL:** total outstanding incl. interest ₹380 cr as on 31-Mar-26 vs agreed ₹700 cr. Cumulative paid over 3 yrs ₹319–320 cr vs agreed ₹271 cr (i.e. prepaid ahead of schedule; ₹47–48 cr prepayment against FY27-28 dues).
- **Arbitration:** ₹312–315 cr awards received since resolution; ~₹627–630 cr awards in hand (advanced/Supreme-Court stage); ~₹4,500 cr additional claims pending (~40% historical conversion → ~₹1,500 cr expected). ~75% of award proceeds routed to NARCL. Mgmt: "effectively a debt-free company" on a cash-flow basis — surplus cash reserved for growth, not NARCL.
- **Liquidity:** ₹476 cr raised since May-2024 (promoter contribution ₹313.5 cr, over and above ₹112.5 cr in the difficult period). Bank credit limit enhanced to ₹505 cr; surety-bond exposure ₹305 cr (in lieu of BG, low margin).

themes.title: Water & environmental-infra EPC
themes.need: AMRUT, Namami Gange and Jal Jeevan still define the pipeline, but Q1FY27 put a number on the funding freeze. WPIL's consolidated revenue rose 32% to INR 501cr while STANDALONE collapsed 37% to INR 115cr as domestic Jal Jeevan invoicing froze, with INR 300-350cr of JJM receivables pending (mostly West Bengal, some MP) and nil received in the quarter - management expects substantial inflow only in Q2/H2. The offsetting discovery is that the theme has quietly become international: WPIL's overseas revenue roughly doubled to INR 386cr, about 77% of consolidated, on PCI Africa's first full execution quarter plus Gruppo Aturia MENA demand, lifting consolidated EBITDA margin to 15.04%. EIEL carries an all-time-high order book (~6x revenue); WABAG on desalination/technology; JISLJALEQS/JISLDVREQS and MAHEPC add micro-irrigation and water-efficiency equipment; EMSLIMITED/SPMLINFRA/JASH/DENTA/ELECTCAST/AWHCL add sewerage, control equipment and ductile-iron piping. Execution conversion, not order intake, remains the binding constraint.
themes.driver: JJM/AMRUT fund releases unlocking billing (WPIL's INR 300-350cr receivable is the tracer); FY27 order inflow; desalination + NTPC BESS EPC ramp; international Africa/MENA execution.
